verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a few narrow event-driven behaviours. Kitty can change color themes automatically when the OS switches between light and dark mode (kitty-docs-21), and lets users fully customize the matching rules and actions of a kitten (kitty-docs-14). It is also scriptable and extensible with Python kittens (kitty-docs-27, kitty-docs-23), though that control is externally driven, not rule-triggered. missing for 10: a documented general-purpose event→action rule or hook system (e.g. triggers on window, command or output events), detail on how such rules are defined, and hands-on or community corroboration of automatic event-triggered actions.
